name: Tomás Achebe-Lindqvist
creator: Tomás Achebe-Lindqvist
description: A former Tier 2 labor documentation clerk who began publishing incendiary political pamphlets through Shelf pirate feed networks in 2196, Achebe-Lindqvist's work fuses meticulous economic data with visceral prose to indict the corponation debt-cycle system. His banned text 'The Arithmetic of Staying Alive' circulates in compressed neural-burst packets — the full document takes eleven seconds to receive and is immediately flagged by corporate monitoring systems. He has been arrested four times and is believed to be currently operating somewhere in the Tier 1-2 border zones.
medium: pirate neural feed burst packets and handprinted zine fragments
cultural_impact: Achebe-Lindqvist's documentation of corponation debt mechanics — presented as narrative rather than report — is used by Shelf advocacy networks as organizing material. Several Tier 4 academics have published responses, which has paradoxically spread his work upward through the tiers.
controversy: Three corponations have issued civil writs naming him as the source of 'coordinated reputational terrorism.' At least one death has been attributed to individuals caught distributing his work. He denies authoring certain texts attributed to him, claiming corporate fabrication to discredit the broader movement.
story_hooks: A player character receives an eleven-second neural burst in a crowded market — they didn't consent to receive it, and now the monitoring flags are on their record.
Achebe-Lindqvist wants to surface publicly for one reading event and needs people he can trust to ensure he survives it.
A text circulating under his name advocates violence — he wants it proven a forgery before it gets people killed in his name.
